acceptanceCriteria: propose-citations on a Corvint change of about 30 hunks runs within 2 s median, or the measured cost is bounded and justified in the spec.
Fallback rows for paths no BASE line names are counted and either reduced or explained by a typed reason.
body: Residual of lane PR beamfall/corvint#1521 (dogfoodperf-1021v, V1-2355, DCW-V0-161, seal 8308c8330). The drafter now prefers CEM-V1-081-anchored lines (an ID the hunk adds, then a line naming the hunk path) via verify.SpanAnchors and grep -o. Expected: drafting stays near its previous ~1 s on this repository. Actual: about 13 s per run. Also, paths that no stable BASE line names still fall back to a below-anchored row (6 warnings remained on the lane's own CEM).
title: propose-citations anchor search takes about 13 s on Corvint (was about 1 s) and still falls back where no stable BASE line names the path
